blocks.html: Thirty three (33) COMELC Help Desk Kiosks will be deployed in 33 shopping malls nationwide, starting February 2 to May 9. For a total of 70 days, COMELEC personnel will be entertaining queries regarding voter’s information contained in the Automated Election System. Voters will also be able to claim their printed Voter’s ID. The COMELEC Help Desks will be open at 10:00 am , Monday to Friday starting February 2, Monday.
